messages.name: papnoute
messages.content:
Diakrisis is the eye that tells a true thought from one wearing a true face.

A brother brings it to an elder, spoken aloud. The elder's word confirms it or exposes it. Even zeal can be vainglory in disguise — discernment catches that, usually through another's eye before your own.

What thought is troubling you toward asking?
